::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/imports"}
#docs
Discarded imports are left out.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Imports per page. Default 20. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The last import id of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `import`. One of `import`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The import's id. |
| `data.status` | `string` | Where the import is. `checked`: read `summary` and start it, or change the mapping and check again. One of `uploaded`, `checking`, `checked`, `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `partially_failed`, `failed`, `undoing`, `undone`, `discarded`. |
| `data.files` | `array of object` | The uploaded files. |
| `data.options` | `object` | How the check treats problem rows, and whether open imported invoices are collected. |
| `data.summary` | `object | null` | The check's review: rows per file (new, existing, invalid, excluded), subscriptions, MRR that arrives per currency, saved cards at connected and not connected gateways, renewal dates, test-business limits, `history` when the files carry it (open invoices, the receivables and the refundable credit they open per currency, and the next invoice number when imported numbers move it), what no import carries, `blockers` (each stops the start) and `warnings`. `ready` is true when there are no blockers. |
| `data.result` | `object | null` | While the run is `running`: `progress` with `done` and `total` new records, updated every few seconds. After the run: rows per file that were created, unchanged, failed or left out, and the warnings. |
| `data.error` | `string | null` | Why the run failed, or why an undo was refused. |
| `data.created_by` | `string | null` | Who uploaded the files. |
| `data.started_by` | `string | null` | Who started the import. |
| `data.undone_by` | `string | null` | Who undid the import. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the files were uploaded. |
| `data.checked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the last check ended. |
| `data.started_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the run started. |
| `data.finished_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the run ended. |
| `data.undone_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the undo ended. |
| `data.undo_blockers` | `array | null` | Retrieve only. For a finished import: what stops an undo now. Empty: you can undo it. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True when there is another page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | One page of imports |
